decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a coherent multi-axis downward step around indices 410–425, and (2) a sharp transient U-drop with partial recovery near 665–675. Both involve abrupt multi-sample changes without full reversal in the observed window; other segments show only noise or smooth trends.

regions.observation: N/E/U all show a coherent, multi-sample downward shift beginning near index 410–415, with N dropping ~2 mm, E ~3 mm, and U ~2 mm; the change is abrupt (2–3 samples) and sustained through ~425, without clear opposing return in this window. Surroundings show typical noise before and after.

U component exhibits a sharp, multi-sample drop (~4 mm) centered at index 668–670, coinciding with a smaller but correlated dip in E (~1.5 mm) and a subtle N inflection; the U drop appears transient—partial recovery begins by 672—but not fully reversed by 675. The event stands out against otherwise smooth drift in this segment.
